en: It will not budge. Something holds it shut.

By order of the garden-keeper: the north gate stays barred until the lantern-lever is thrown. Mind the thorns.
The lever gives with a heavy clack. Somewhere north, iron shifts.
The lever settles back. The sound of iron returns.
The gate grinds open onto the dark.
The rose-scent thickens as you step onto the dais.

Back again. The roses have not moved, in case you were wondering.

I keep the garden. That is the whole of it, and it is more than enough.
